name: Replicating Pairs Trading
description: Reproduce the classic pairs trading study and measure how much of the profit remains.

lessonNames.l13-just-a-factor: Is it just a risk factor?

lessonObjectives.l1-ggr-design: Describe the formation and trading periods of the distance method.
lessonObjectives.l2-normalised-paths: Normalise prices and measure the distance between two paths.
lessonObjectives.l4-main-results: Read the paper’s main table of returns.
lessonObjectives.l5-plan: Write a replication plan with checks at every step.
lessonObjectives.l6-two-standard-deviations: Open a trade when the spread diverges by two standard deviations.
lessonObjectives.l7-closing: Close trades at convergence or at the end of the period.
lessonObjectives.l8-committed-capital: Compute returns on committed and on employed capital.
lessonObjectives.l9-bid-ask-bounce: Account for costs and the bid-ask bounce.
lessonObjectives.l10-matching-results: Compare your returns with the paper’s and explain the gaps.
lessonObjectives.l11-why-profits-fell: Measure the decline in pairs profits after publication.
lessonObjectives.l12-cointegration-selection: Compare cointegration-based pair selection with the distance method.
lessonObjectives.l13-just-a-factor: Regress pairs returns on factor returns.
lessonObjectives.l14-out-of-sample: Extend the strategy to recent data.
lessonObjectives.l15-pairs-note: Write the replication note, including what did not survive.
